# Astro Chat

> Astro Chat is an Android mobile application (`com.astrochat.astrology`) delivering authentic Vedic astrology calculations, instant private 1-on-1 consultations with verified astrologers, high-precision Kundli life predictions, 36/36 Guna marriage compatibility matching, ancient Tamil Pancha Pakshi daily biorhythm tracking, and GPS-personalized auspicious timing heatmaps.

## Core Features & Capabilities

- [Home Dashboard](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#features): Central launchpad featuring Vedic Life Prediction, Pancha Pakshi, Good Time Finder, Match Maker, Live Astrologers, Horoscope Matrimony, and rotating Kundli Sun Chakra.
- [Life Prediction](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#life-prediction): Planetary ephemeris calculation of Career, Love, Health, and Financial trajectories derived from accurate date, time, and birthplace coordinates.
- [Pancha Pakshi](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#pancha-pakshi): Ancient Tamil five-bird astrological system identifying the user's ruling bird (Vulture, Owl, Crow, Cock, Peacock) and daily biorhythm states (Rule, Eat, Walk, Sleep, Die).
- [Good Time Finder](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#good-time): Real-time color-coded hourly heatmap highlighting auspicious windows (Shubh Muhurat) for job transitions, business deals, travel, and investments, while alerting against Rahu Kaalam.
- [Match Maker (Kundli Milan)](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#match-maker): Comprehensive 36/36 Guna Ashta-Koota compatibility score, Manglik / Kuja Dosha detection, Nadi check, and Rasi harmony for prospective couples.
- [Live Astrologers](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#astrologers): Instant access to verified master practitioners of Vedic Astrology, Numerology, Tarot, and Lal Kitab with multi-language support (Tamil, Hindi, English, Kannada, Telugu).
- [Horoscope Matrimony](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#matrimony): Curated profiles of singles whose birth charts and planetary alignments are pre-screened for astrological compatibility.
- [Private Consultation Chat](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#chat): End-to-end confidential 1-on-1 chat room with instant multi-language translation (e.g. English ⇄ Tamil) and voice note support.
- [Free Offer Gate](https://astro-chat-web.vercel.app/#offer): First chat question is 100% free with no credit card required, plus 1 month free access to personalized Kundli predictions.

## Legal & Compliance Documents
